steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Allocate approximately 1 minute per mark: a 3-mark question gets about 3 minutes; leave 5–10 minutes at the end for checking

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Attempt every question — there are no negative marks; even an educated guess on a multiple-choice question is worthwhile

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Check answers systematically: re-read the question, verify units, confirm calculations, and apply reasonableness checks

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: When checking, work backwards from your answer or use an alternative method to verify; if both methods agree, the answer is likely correct

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: A paper has 80 marks and lasts 90 minutes. How long should you spend on a 4-mark question? | Q: You calculate the mean of a data set as 2847. The data ranges from 10 to 50. What should you do? | Q: Name two advantages of entering data into a calculator’s statistics mode rather than calculating the mean by hand.

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: Time per mark = 90 ÷ 80 ≈ 1.125 minutes. A 4-mark question should take roughly 4.5 minutes. If you spend more than 5 minutes, move on and return later. | The answer is unreasonable. A mean of 2847 cannot come from data in the range 10–50. Re-check the calculation: likely an error in the formula, using wrong values, or a calculator input mistake. | 1) Speed: the calculator computes mean, SD and other statistics instantly. 2) Accuracy: no arithmetic errors in summing or dividing, provided data is entered correctly.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: If you are stuck on a question for more than 2 minutes, move on and come back — easier marks may be waiting later in the paper Always write something for every part of a question: even a formula or a known fact can earn a method mark In the calculator paper, double-check data entry by using the count function (n) to verify the number of data points matches the question Before the exam, practise locating each formula on the formula sheet so you can find it quickly under time pressure Use the 5–10 minutes of checking time to verify: (1) every question has been attempted, (2) answers have units, (3) calculations are reasonable
